title: Planned live demo at Electrostatic Society of America conference

tellings.quote: my lab is um that's in Cocoa Beach Florida and I will do a live demo of this.

plain: A scientist named Charles Buhler, presented on the show as a NASA figure who says his team has built a propulsion system that works against gravity, plans to show it working in public. He tells Michels that at a conference of the Electrostatic Society of America he will "do a live demo of this," at his lab in Cocoa Beach, Florida.
